newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks fall in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks fall in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks fell in early morning trade on Thursday. Brokers said the bottom side was still vulnerable, but the launch of new investment trust funds could prompt hopes of inflows of money to underpin the market.
At 0014 GMT, the benchmark Nikkei 225 average was down 167.30 points or 0.86 percent at 19,382.1. March Nikkei futures were 140 points lower at 19,390.

Brokers also said share prices might be weighed down by selling from individual investors, as they are expected to close their positions ahead of settlement days for margin trading at the end of this year and in early January.
